description:
About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

TopFoxx | Remote | Full-Time

 

Location: Remote (must work U.S. East Coast hours).

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Hours are flexible. We care about performance, not clocks.

Salary: $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.

Language: Perfect written and spoken English is required (this is non-negotiable), along with a deep understanding of U.S. culture, slang, and social media behavior.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned fashion startup reinventing the sunglasses industry with solution-oriented designs and bold branding. Since 2016, we have grown from a bootstrapped e-commerce brand into a global business serving hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by an engaged community of influencers and creators.

We are not here to follow trends. We create them. Our sunglasses are tangle-free, floatable, foldable, shatter-resistant, and sustainably made, and we are just getting started.

We are a small, lean, founder-led team of fewer than ten people, with only about three of us on marketing. That means there is nowhere to hide and no one to pass the work to. Everyone wears multiple hats, owns real outcomes, and what you build genuinely moves the company. We do not do slow. We move fast, we pivot often, and we only hire A-players who treat the business like their own.




The Role

You will be the main one. This is the person who owns influencer and affiliate marketing end to end at TopFoxx. You are not waiting for a manual or a list of tasks. You are expected to bring the strategy, bring the ideas, and then execute them yourself, fast.

This space changes daily. New creators, new trends, new platform rules. You have to move quickly, test constantly, double down on what converts, and cut what does not. We are not looking for someone who only posts and reports. We are looking for a real executor who is proactive, creative, and obsessed with one thing above all: profitable, converting partnerships.

This is a big opportunity, and we want to be honest with you: it is also real work. We already have a large base of affiliates and creators, but your job is to grow it, activate it, and make it far more profitable. This is not a coast-along role. You will be building, pushing, and problem-solving every single day. For the right person, that is exactly the appeal.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct path into leading the influencer marketing function as it scales.




Why This Is Worth It

Here is the honest pitch. This is not a maintenance job and it is not busywork. Influencer and affiliate marketing is one of the biggest growth levers we have, and we believe this channel can become a multi-million dollar engine for TopFoxx. We are looking for the person who can build that.

We reward outcomes, not hours. If you can show us you can grow this and drive real, profitable revenue, you grow with it. That means a clear path into leadership and compensation that reflects the results you create. The ceiling here is high for someone who actually delivers, and you will be able to point to a business you helped build, not just tasks you completed.

If you want to be a small piece of a big machine, this is not it. If you want real ownership, real upside, and to look back in a year knowing you built something that matters, keep reading.




1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Program (Your Primary Focus)

This is the heart of the role and where most of your time and energy goes. The big one is affiliate. Your job is to make sure the affiliates are converting, the program is profitable, and the numbers in TikTok Shop Seller Center are strong and trending up.

Own TikTok Shop Seller Center day to day. Live in the dashboards, know your numbers cold, and make sure performance is healthy across GMV, conversion, and orders.
Make the affiliate program profitable. Track and grow GMV, revenue per creator, sample-to-sales ROI, and commission costs. Protect margin. Every dollar of product and commission has to earn its return.
Build and manage a pipeline of hundreds to thousands of active TikTok Shop affiliates, and keep them actually posting and selling, not just signing up.
Recruit high-converting creators and live sellers who know how to talk about product and drive sales, not just collect free samples.
Go live and sell yourself. You will host TikTok Lives, get on camera, and sell the glasses directly. Then you bring affiliates on, show them how it is done, and coach them to do the same.
Coordinate TikTok Live schedules with strong sellers, secure Spark Ads permissions, and optimize listings and content angles for maximum GMV.
Watch performance weekly. Scale top converters aggressively, and cut low performers fast.
Keep the data honest. No padded numbers, no inflated reporting. Decisions are only as good as the data behind them.




2. Instagram Influencers

Instagram is the second pillar. Here we work on gifting and affiliate only, so your skill is finding the right people and getting them to convert without a paid budget.

Source Instagram influencers who can actually sell, creators who understand product and know how to drive their audience to buy, not just post a pretty photo.
Run gifting-only and affiliate-only collaborations, and move creators from one gift to repeat posting to consistent affiliate sales.
Rebuild our existing relationships. We have lists of past and dormant influencers. A big part of this role is reigniting those relationships and turning old contacts back into active, converting partners.
Build genuine, consistent relationships so TopFoxx stays top of mind, through thoughtful, regular touchpoints across Instagram and DMs.




3. LTK, Affiliate Platforms & Onboarding Calls

The third pillar is affiliate-driven platforms like LTK, and just as important, getting on calls with creators. This role is not behind a screen all day. You have to be outgoing and genuinely good at talking to people.

Recruit and activate creators on LTK and other affiliate networks (Amazon, affiliate links) who are still actively driving commission-based sales.
Run weekly onboarding calls. You will be on calls regularly, onboarding new influencers, walking them through the program, and getting them excited and set up to post.
Get on calls and close collabs. Be confident and persuasive, build rapport quickly, and convince creators to say yes to working with us, often with gifting only.
Understand creator psychology and motivate influencers to post consistently through relationship, community value, and a clear win for them.




4. Strategy, Reporting & Full Influencer Marketing Scope

Because you own this function, you also handle everything a strong e-commerce influencer marketing lead would handle. Study what bigger e-commerce brands do, then adapt the best of it to a lean, fast-moving team.

Build the strategy. Bring a clear point of view on where influencer and affiliate marketing is going and how TopFoxx wins, then put it into action.
Plan and execute campaigns tied to product launches, holidays, seasonal moments, and major sales events (BFCM, summer, new drops).
Manage content calendars, gifting coordination, sample sends, and follow-ups so nothing slips.
Build weekly performance reports that connect activity to revenue, and use them to decide what to scale and what to kill.
Create simple SOPs, trackers, and playbooks as you go, so the program is repeatable and scalable as the team grows.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and product teams to keep messaging aligned, and step in on urgent launch-related projects when needed.
Stay ahead of trends, new creators, and new affiliate opportunities before competitors do.
Help with wider marketing as needed. With a team this small, marketing is just three people and everyone pitches in. From time to time things will come up across other marketing areas and departments that need a hand. We need someone proactive and solution-oriented who brings energy, jumps in, and helps build this with us rather than sitting idle.




Who You Are

Proactive: You see the gap and fill it. You bring the plan, you do not wait to be told.
A real executor: You move fast, ship daily, and adapt as things change hour to hour.
Analytical and profit-obsessed: You can read a Seller Center dashboard, understand ROI and margin, and turn data into decisions.
Persuasive and outgoing: You love talking to creators, you are comfortable on camera and on calls, and you can sell the partnership and the product.
Relationship-driven: You are a natural connector who builds loyalty and keeps partners coming back.
Organized under pressure: You can juggle hundreds of moving pieces without dropping the ball.




Required Experience & Skills

2+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, preferably in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce / DTC.
Expert, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center mechanics and affiliate programs.
Proven track record of generating real sales through gifting-only or zero-budget strategies.
Comfort with LTK, Amazon, and other affiliate platforms.
Comfortable on camera and hosting TikTok Lives to sell product directly.
Perfect written and spoken English, and a strong understanding of U.S. culture and digital trends. This is genuinely important.
KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.




What You Get

Salary of $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.
A fully remote role on a fast-moving global team.
Real ownership of the influencer and affiliate function, with a path into leadership as it scales.
PTO including vacation, holidays, sick, personal, and mental health days.
Free TopFoxx products and partner brand perks.

About the job

Paid Ads Strategist

Remote | Medical Aesthetics Marketing | 30-35 Client Portfolio







We Don't Need a Media Buyer. We Need a Marketer.

If you think your job ends when someone clicks an ad, this isn't for you.

We need someone who obsesses over the entire journey: Ad → Landing Page → Email/SMS → Booking → Treatment. We don't celebrate leads. We celebrate people walking through the door.







The Role

You're a full-stack marketer who's deep in Meta and Google ads but understands how everything connects. You can write killer ad copy, optimize a landing page, fix a broken funnel, and explain strategy on a client call.

You'll manage paid advertising for 30-40 medical spa clients and drive the strategy for your portfolio with the support of an Account Manager.







What You Actually Do

Lead Strategy

Run weekly internal team meetings - what's working, what's not, what to test
Analyze full funnel performance: ads, landing pages, follow-up, bookings
Make calls on when to scale, pivot, or pause

Execute Campaigns

Build and optimize Meta and Google campaigns daily
Write ad copy that converts
Test creative angles, audiences, offers, landing pages
Optimize for bookings and treatment rates, not just leads

Think Full Funnel

Fix broken landing pages that aren't converting
Design email/SMS sequences that drive bookings
Understand consumer psychology: What makes someone book their first Botox?
Connect ad spend to actual practice revenue

Collaborate

Work with designers on creative concepts and angles (you're the creative director)
Partner with Account Manager on client strategy
Join client calls when performance needs strategic intervention
Spot upsell opportunities







You're the Right Person If:

✅ Expert in Meta ads, strong in Google Ads - with 3+ years experience and proven results

✅ Can write compelling ad copy and landing page copy

✅ Understand full-funnel marketing (not just traffic)

✅ Comfortable on client calls explaining strategy

✅ Lead meetings with clear POV, not just data dumps

✅ Collaborate with designers like a creative director

✅ Constant learner who studies competitors and tests new approaches

✅ Care about business outcomes (bookings) not vanity metrics (leads)

Bonus: Medical aesthetics background, GoHighLevel knowledge







What We DON'T Want

❌ Media buyers who optimize in a vacuum

❌ Order-takers waiting to be told what to do

❌ People who think "leads are up" = success

❌ Specialists who can't see the bigger picture







About Tier3 Media

We're a digital marketing agency exclusively serving 100+ medical spas nationwide. We're growth partners who understand the aesthetics industry deeply.

What we offer: Ownership over your portfolio, clear growth path, cutting-edge tools, remote flexibility, competitive pay

About the job

Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.

Your Purpose 

We're looking for a resourceful, analytical, and execution-obsessed B2B Growth Marketing Specialist to become the operational backbone of our marketing team. This is a hybrid role that spans demand generation, event operations, campaign execution, and marketing ops, all with a relentless focus on pipeline growth and efficiency.

You'll own programs end-to-end: from building the strategy and managing vendor relationships to tracking budgets, analyzing results, and iterating fast. Events are an important part of the mix, but so are ABM plays, content-driven lead gen, partner marketing, and everything in between.

We need someone who doesn't wait for instructions. You see a gap, you fill it. You use AI tools daily to multiply your output. You're as comfortable building a campaign report in HubSpot as you are negotiating a venue contract or writing a landing page brief. If you thrive in fast-paced, "do more with less" environments, this role is for you.

Reports To

Senior Marketing Manager for Bitso Business - Ingrid Carraro

Who You Are 



4+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in roles that combined demand gen, events, and marketing ops.
A genuine growth mindset — you're metrics-driven, experiment-happy, and always looking for the next lever to pull.
Solid experience managing events and marketing budgets, vendor contracts, and multi-vendor logistics.
Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot (Marketing Hub & CRM).
Strong analytical skills: you're comfortable in spreadsheets, dashboards, and data. You make decisions with numbers, not gut feeling.
Heavy, daily user of AI tools: you already use AI to write, analyze, automate, and create. This is non-negotiable.
Exceptional organizational skills: you manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders without dropping balls.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Spanish.
Based in Mexico City with availability for occasional travel.
Nice-to-Have
Experience in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS B2B environments.
Familiarity with ABM platforms (Demandbase, 6sense, HubSpot ABM).
Experience with paid media management (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta).
Knowledge of SEO/SEM fundamentals and content marketing strategy.
Experience with analytics and BI tools (Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau).

Event Marketing & Field Programs
Manage the end-to-end logistics of B2B marketing events: trade shows, hosted dinners, executive roundtables, webinars, virtual summits, and partner activations.
Source, negotiate, and manage external vendors (venues, A/V, catering, booth production, swag, event platforms) and own all related contracts and payments.

Identify and implement automation opportunities to eliminate manual, repetitive work across marketing operations.

description:
About the job

At Siemens Digital Industries Software, you will join a globally distributed team leading the future of people-first marketing. This role focuses on driving demand through our channel ecosystem by executing targeted marketing programs with both regional and global impact.

As a Channel Field Marketing Professional, you will work closely with channel sales leadership and partners to identify growth opportunities, activate campaigns, and increase partner-driven pipeline. You will take a proactive, data-informed approach to engaging partners and reactivating dormant accounts, ensuring our Xcelerator portfolio is effectively positioned and adopted in the market.

You will be encouraged to innovate while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Roles & Responsibilities


Align with channel sales leadership to define regional priorities, target accounts, and the required marketing impact on partner-driven pipeline and revenue
Drive and execute regional channel marketing plans that support strategic growth goals, including partner activation, demand generation, and account expansion
Identify and activate high-potential opportunities, including targeting disengaged or dormant accounts and launching re-engagement campaigns
Execute localized campaigns targeting SMBs, ensuring effective use of global content and adapting for regional needs and partner demand fulfillment
Partner with Channel sales, Global Industry planners, and Zone teams to align investment priorities and select programs with the highest ROI
Ensuring marketing programs translate into viable opportunities for partners
Own performance tracking across the demand waterfall, including partner-led pipeline, progression, and conversion
Provide regional channel insights and act as the voice of the region to content and central teams
Collaborate with Data and Content teams to optimize targeting, spend, and campaign effectiveness
Communicate clearly across stakeholders to ensure alignment and visibility into plans and results


Skills & Abilities Required


Strong understanding of channel marketing and partner-driven demand generation
Ability to translate sales priorities into executable marketing programs
Experience working across regional teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders
Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decisions
Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
Ability to operate proactively and independently


Key Requirements


Deep understanding of the B2B sales cycle, especially in partner-led models
Experience driving pipeline through partners including campaign adoption and opportunity creation
Familiarity with B2B demand generation and revenue waterfall metrics
Ability to align strategy to execution and deliver results on time and within budget
Strong project management discipline
Experience in inbound and account-based marketing
Highly collaborative and adaptable


Measures of Success


New partner-generated opportunities
Workable opportunities delivered to partners
Channel pipeline contribution and progression
Conversion of re-engaged dormant accounts


Education & Experience


Undergraduate degree in Marketing or Business is preferred.
5+ years of proven experience in B2B software marketing, ideally with channel or partner marketing exposure.
Ability to market to a range of B2B buying groups using a wide variety of offers and delivery mechanisms
Proven ability to align tactical plans with strategies, consistently producing results on time and within budget
Proficiency with project management tools and ability to keep projects on schedule
Fluent in English and Spanish with highly effective communication across all mediums
15% travel per year (3 to 4 events/meetings annually)


Our Benefits & Rewards

The salary range for this position is 498,600 MXN to 1,096,900 MXN and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

Once you apply, you will complete a short 2-minute video question — a portfolio of published content and link-earning campaigns will be required. We can't wait to meet you!

About the job

At Siemens Digital Industries Software, you will join a globally distributed team leading the future of people-first marketing. This role focuses on driving demand through our channel ecosystem by executing targeted marketing programs with both regional and global impact.

As a Channel Field Marketing Professional, you will work closely with channel sales leadership and partners to identify growth opportunities, activate campaigns, and increase partner-driven pipeline. You will take a proactive, data-informed approach to engaging partners and reactivating dormant accounts, ensuring our Xcelerator portfolio is effectively positioned and adopted in the market.

You will be encouraged to innovate while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Roles & Responsibilities


Align with channel sales leadership to define regional priorities, target accounts, and the required marketing impact on partner-driven pipeline and revenue
Drive and execute regional channel marketing plans that support strategic growth goals, including partner activation, demand generation, and account expansion
Identify and activate high-potential opportunities, including targeting disengaged or dormant accounts and launching re-engagement campaigns
Execute localized campaigns targeting SMBs, ensuring effective use of global content and adapting for regional needs and partner demand fulfillment
Partner with Channel sales, Global Industry planners, and Zone teams to align investment priorities and select programs with the highest ROI
Ensuring marketing programs translate into viable opportunities for partners
Own performance tracking across the demand waterfall, including partner-led pipeline, progression, and conversion
Provide regional channel insights and act as the voice of the region to content and central teams
Collaborate with Data and Content teams to optimize targeting, spend, and campaign effectiveness
Communicate clearly across stakeholders to ensure alignment and visibility into plans and results


Skills & Abilities Required


Strong understanding of channel marketing and partner-driven demand generation
Ability to translate sales priorities into executable marketing programs
Experience working across regional teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders
Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decisions
Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
Ability to operate proactively and independently


Key Requirements


Deep understanding of the B2B sales cycle, especially in partner-led models
Experience driving pipeline through partners including campaign adoption and opportunity creation
Familiarity with B2B demand generation and revenue waterfall metrics
Ability to align strategy to execution and deliver results on time and within budget
Strong project management discipline
Experience in inbound and account-based marketing
Highly collaborative and adaptable


Measures of Success


New partner-generated opportunities
Workable opportunities delivered to partners
Channel pipeline contribution and progression
Conversion of re-engaged dormant accounts


Education & Experience


Undergraduate degree in Marketing or Business is preferred.
5+ years of proven experience in B2B software marketing, ideally with channel or partner marketing exposure.
Ability to market to a range of B2B buying groups using a wide variety of offers and delivery mechanisms
Proven ability to align tactical plans with strategies, consistently producing results on time and within budget
Proficiency with project management tools and ability to keep projects on schedule
Fluent in English and Spanish with highly effective communication across all mediums
15% travel per year (3 to 4 events/meetings annually)


Our Benefits & Rewards

The salary range for this position is 498,600 MXN to 1,096,900 MXN and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
About the job

Acerca de Emeritus

En Emeritus creemos que los líderes construyen del mundo un lugar mejor. Nuestra misión es democratizar el acceso a educación de clase mundial, colaborando con las mejores escuelas de negocio del planeta — MIT Sloan, Columbia Business School, Tuck School of Business, entre otras. Ofrecemos cursos, certificados y maestrías en inglés, español, mandarín y portugués, impactando a más de 300,000 estudiantes en +100 países.




Acerca del Puesto

El Marketing Automation Specialist será el arquitecto de los flujos de comunicación digital que guían a los prospectos desde el primer intento de contacto hasta la inscripción en programas de Emeritus. Esta persona será responsable de diseñar, implementar y optimizar journeys automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, gestionar campañas multicanal (email y WhatsApp), y medir el impacto de cada acción con KPIs claros.

El rol requiere una mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados: entender el origen y comportamiento de los prospectos, explorar patrones de interacción, detectar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para maximizar la tasa de inscripción.




Funciones Principales

1. Diseño e Implementación de Flujos Automatizados

• Mapear y comprender las fuentes de prospectos (paid media, orgánico, referidos, alianzas) y sus comportamientos para diseñar customer journeys relevantes.

• Diseñar, construir y lanzar flujos automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio) alineados a cada etapa del funnel.

• Definir lógicas de segmentación, personalización y ramificaciones basadas en comportamiento (aperturas, clics, formularios, tiempo en el funnel).

• Proponer y desarrollar nuevas automatizaciones para mejorar la conversión y la eficiencia operativa del equipo.

• Coordinar con redactores y diseñadores para solicitar los copies y materiales necesarios para cada flujo.




2. Gestión de Campañas y Envíos

• Ejecutar campañas automatizadas y envíos manuales (email y WhatsApp) garantizando correcta segmentación, personalización y calendarización.

• Configurar templates responsivos y asegurar su correcta renderización en múltiples clientes de correo.

• Dar seguimiento a indicadores clave: open rate, CTR, entregabilidad, tasa de bajas y conversión.

• Generar insights accionables a partir del análisis de resultados para iterar y mejorar campañas de forma continua.




3. Medición, Análisis y Optimización con KPIs

• Definir y monitorear KPIs de cada flujo automatizado: tasa de apertura, tasa de conversión por etapa, costo por lead calificado, tiempo promedio en el funnel.

• Generar reportes periódicos de desempeño de campañas y journeys con análisis comparativo.

• Proponer y ejecutar pruebas A/B (asunto, copy, horario de envío, CTA) para optimizar resultados.

• Identificar cuellos de botella en los flujos y proponer mejoras basadas en datos para incrementar el número de inscritos.

• Colaborar en la construcción de dashboards de seguimiento con el equipo de BI o Performance.




4. Gestión de Landing Pages y Contenido

• Desarrollar y publicar landing pages en Contentful (CMS), asegurando alineación con lineamientos de marca y objetivos de conversión.

• Coordinar la correcta implementación de materiales digitales (banners, formularios, UTMs).

• Colaborar en la generación de contenido para campañas (email, WhatsApp, LP) con enfoque en conversión.




5. Coordinación y Trabajo en Equipo

• Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para alinear flujos con objetivos comerciales.

• Apoyar en la ejecución de materiales y campañas para lanzamientos de nuevos programas.

• Gestionar solicitudes derivadas de flujos automatizados (leads, materiales, LPs) con agilidad y criterio.

• Participar activamente en reuniones de planeación, retrospectivas y sesiones de mejora continua.




KPIs de Éxito del Rol

KPI / Métrica Objetivo / Referencia

Tasa de apertura de emails ≥ 25% promedio en flujos clave

Click-Through Rate (CTR) ≥ 3% en campañas de nurturing

Tasa de conversión por etapa del funnel Mejora trimestral sostenida

Número de inscritos generados por flujos automatizados Meta definida por campaña/programa

Entregabilidad de emails ≥ 95% (spam rate < 0.1%)

Tiempo de implementación de nuevos flujos < 5 días hábiles para flujos estándar

Uptime de journeys activos 99% sin interrupciones no planificadas

NPS interno (satisfacción de equipos

colaboradores) ≥ 4/5 trimestral




Requisitos del Candidato

Educación y Experiencia

• Licenciatura en Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Sistemas o afín.

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en Marketing Automation, CRM o Email Marketing.

• Experiencia comprobable con Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder).

• Experiencia en diseño y análisis de flujos de comunicación automatizada orientados a conversión.




Habilidades Técnicas

• Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio — nivel avanzado.

• Conocimiento de AMPscript o SQL para personalización dinámica de contenido (deseable).

• HTML y CSS para maquetación de emails responsivos.

• Manejo de plataformas de mensajería: WhatsApp Business API o similares.

• CMS: Contentful o equivalente para gestión de landing pages.

• Dominio de MS Office / Google Workspace; Excel avanzado para análisis de datos.

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (lectura de documentación técnica y comunicación con equipos globales).




Competencias Clave

• Pensamiento analítico y orientado a datos — toma de decisiones basada en métricas.

• Visión de funnel — capacidad de entender el recorrido del prospecto de inicio a fin.

• Atención al detalle — cero errores en envíos masivos y configuración de journeys.

• Proactividad — capacidad de identificar oportunidades de mejora sin esperar instrucciones.

• Trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con áreas multidisciplinarias.

• Autogestión y manejo del tiempo en modalidad 100% home office.

• Orientación a resultados — enfoque constante en incrementar el número de inscritos.




Deseable (Nice to Have)

• Certificación en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist o Marketing Cloud Consultant).

• Experiencia en sector EdTech o empresas de suscripción con funnels de conversión complejos.

• Conocimiento de herramientas de analytics: GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau o Power BI.

• Experiencia con pruebas A/B y metodologías de optimización de conversión (CRO).

• Conocimiento básico de APIs REST para integración de fuentes de prospectos.




¿Por qué unirte a Emeritus?

• Impacto real: tus flujos automatizados conectarán a miles de profesionales con las mejores universidades del mundo.

• Crecimiento acelerado: empresa global en expansión con oportunidades de desarrollo internacional.

• Tecnología de punta: trabajarás con Salesforce Marketing Cloud en escala real de LATAM.

• Equipo de alto desempeño: colaborarás con expertos en performance, ventas y producto.

• Flexibilidad: 100% home office con horarios estables y cultura orientada a resultados.

• Prestaciones superiores: IMSS completo + Seguro de Vida + Gastos Médicos Mayores desde el día 1.

About the job

Business Cultivation Lead (Location: Mexico City)




Curioso is a collective of architects, interior designers, and artists designing meaningful experiences around the world. Our award-winning projects represent a range of industries, including luxury hospitality, lifestyle hospitality, restaurant, wellness, multifamily, and professional spaces. We're a collaborative studio driven by curiosity, empathy, and an entrepreneurial spirit, with a diverse, multicultural team across our studios in Chicago, IL, and Mérida, Yucatán, México.




We're looking for a Business Cultivation Lead to join our team.







Position Overview




We are looking for a Business Cultivation Lead to work closely alongside our Managing Partner in identifying, pursuing, and winning the right work. This is a senior, independent role for someone who understands the luxury hospitality market deeply. We are looking for someone who has genuine relationships, sharp instincts about where a project is headed, and the discipline to manage a complex pipeline without losing momentum.




This person carries the business development function day-to-day. That means first outreach, relationship stewardship, RFP analysis, go/no-go discipline, fee structuring, and conference presence — with the judgment to know when to bring in others and when to move independently. You will not be executing someone else's strategy. You will be building it as part of a strategic team.




We are looking for someone who is bilingual, at home in both U.S. and Latin American hospitality markets, understanding what makes a studio like Curioso distinct — and why that distinction matters when you're sitting across from a developer who has ten firms in their inbox.




Responibilities




Pipeline & Market Intelligence




Maintain a rigorous, current view of the pipeline: active pursuits, warm relationships, and longer-horizon opportunities, using CRM with discipline and consistency
Monitor RFP activity, industry movements, and developer news across the U.S., Mexico, and CALA to identify opportunities before they become formal solicitations
Track the competitive landscape: who is winning what work, where Curioso is well-positioned, and where we're underrepresented




Pursuit Strategy & Go/No-Go




Lead the go/no-go evaluation for each incoming opportunity: assessing fee potential, scope fit, competitive position, client profile, and strategic alignment
Develop pursuit strategy for each active proposal: what to lead with, what to show, who the right contact is, and how to frame Curioso's value in this specific context
Build and manage the fee calculation process: understanding Curioso's internal cost structure, the right fee range for a given scope, and presenting a clear rationale internally before any number goes to a client




Relationship Development




Maintain and grow a personal network of developers, operators, brand owners, architects, and consultants across U.S., Mexico, and CALA markets
Lead first-contact outreach for new opportunities, representing Curioso with warmth, precision, and genuine curiosity about the project
Own pre-proposal relationship conversations: discovery calls, site visits, and early alignment meetings — and translate what you learn into a pursuit strategy
Represent Curioso at key industry conferences (BDNY, Hospitality Design, HVS events, regional events in Mexico and the Caribbean) with a clear plan for who to see and what to advance




Proposal & Pitch Leadership




Lead the proposal process end-to-end: structuring the narrative, coordinating with the BD Designer on production, reviewing for accuracy and tone, and delivering on time
Translate complex project information into clear, client-facing language — fee structures, scope definitions, process explanations — without losing the story
Work with the Managing Partner to prepare for and lead presentations and shortlist interviews




Internal Alignment




Keep studio owners and senior leadership aligned on pursuit status, decision points, and pipeline health — creating visibility without creating noise
Flag misaligned opportunities early and frame the decision clearly: here's what we'd be saying yes to, here's what we'd be declining, here's why







Requirements




8+ years of experience in business development, client relations, or strategic pursuit roles within luxury hospitality design, architecture, or a closely related field
Genuine fluency in the luxury hospitality development landscape — you know the developers, operators, and brands that matter, and you understand how projects are financed, structured, and selected
Bilingual in English and Spanish, with active relationships in Mexico and/or CALA markets
Based in or willing to relocate to Miami, Florida, OR located in Mexico City or Mérida, with expectation of regular U.S. travel
Strong analytical instincts: you can read a scope, calculate a fee, assess a competitive field, and make a clear recommendation
A communicator who writes and speaks with clarity and precision
Deeply curious about design, hospitality, culture, and place — this is not a role for someone who sells services they don't believe in
Comfortable with ambiguity and a rigorous pace — this is a growing studio, not a process-heavy institution







What This Is Not




This is not a coordinator role with a senior title. We need someone who will have their own relationships, make their own calls, and build something — not someone executing a checklist. Aldea es una plataforma para la gestión y administración de centros educativos. Hoy ayudamos a más de 400 centros (kínderes, guarderías, primarias, centros de terapia, idiomas y deporte) a optimizar su comunicación, administración y procesos pedagógicos.

description:
About the job

Estoy ayudando a Afincore a encontrar al mejor candidato para unirse a su equipo flexible para el rol de AI Sales Partner.




Convertirás problemas críticos de negocio en soluciones ejecutables de datos, IA y software.




Compensación:

USD 0/mes




Ubicación:

Remoto: México




Misión de Afincore:

"Desarrollar infraestructura de inteligencia artificial, datos y software empresarial que permita a las organizaciones tomar decisiones estratégicas con mayor precisión."




¿Qué te hace un candidato ideal?

Eres competente en Venta consultiva, Gestión comercial, Desarrollo de red de contactos, Desarrollo de negocios, CRM.
Tienes potencial para desarrollar Snowflake, SPIN selling, Rentabilidad, Microsoft Azure, Intelligent automation (IA), Ingeniería de datos, Finanzas corporativas.
Español - Completamente fluido
Inglés - Conversacional




Responsabilidades y más:

AI Sales Partner




Business Development & AI Solutions - Afincore




Ubicación: México / Remoto

Modalidad: Contractor por proyecto

Compensación: 10% de utilidades netas por proyecto cerrado

Nivel: Mid-Senior / Senior




Sobre Afincore




Afincore es una firma de inteligencia corporativa, ingeniería de datos, infraestructura de IA y desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas para negocios.




Ayudamos a empresas, grupos empresariales y equipos directivos a convertir datos dispersos, reportes manuales y decisiones intuitivas en sistemas de inteligencia empresarial: Command Centers, Control Towers, Profitability Engines, Growth Control Systems, AI Operating Layers y Enterprise Intelligence OS.




No construimos dashboards genéricos. Construimos infraestructura de decisión.




Sobre el Rol




Buscamos un AI Sales Partner para originar, desarrollar y convertir oportunidades comerciales en proyectos reales de datos, IA, analítica y software para Afincore.




La persona será responsable de identificar organizaciones con problemas relevantes de información, rentabilidad, operación, reporting, crecimiento o automatización; abrir conversaciones con los decisores adecuados; entender el problema y trabajar con el liderazgo y equipo técnico de Afincore para construir una solución comercial y técnicamente viable.




Este no es un rol de venta transaccional ni de colocación de licencias cerradas. Afincore desarrolla soluciones personalizadas: para un cliente la arquitectura adecuada puede apoyarse en MotherDuck; para otro en Snowflake, AWS, herramientas existentes o una combinación distinta.




Trabajarás de forma remota y con alta autonomía, participando desde la prospección y discovery hasta la propuesta, negociación, cierre y transición del proyecto al equipo de implementación.




Qué harás




* Identificar y prospectar empresas con problemas que puedan resolverse mediante datos, IA, analítica o software.

* Construir y gestionar pipeline comercial mediante outbound, referidos, networking, alianzas y otras fuentes de oportunidad.

* Abrir conversaciones con dueños, CEOs, CFOs, COOs y otros decisores relevantes.

* Liderar reuniones iniciales de discovery para entender el negocio antes de proponer tecnología.

* Detectar problemas como información fragmentada, reportes manuales, falta de visibilidad operativa, márgenes desconocidos, forecasting débil, procesos repetitivos o sistemas desconectados.

* Trabajar con clientes que, en ocasiones, llegan con información desordenada y necesitan estructurar el problema prácticamente desde cero.

* Coordinar con el CEO y equipo técnico de Afincore diagnósticos, arquitecturas preliminares y propuestas.

* Presentar soluciones de forma ejecutiva, explicando valor, alcance, fases y lógica económica sin recurrir a hype tecnológico.

* Dar seguimiento a propuestas, negociación, cierre y handoff al equipo de delivery.

* Mantener disciplina de CRM, seguimiento, forecast comercial y documentación de oportunidades.

* Desarrollar alianzas y convertir aprendizajes de mercado en inteligencia reutilizable para el go-to-market de Afincore.




Soluciones que Comercializarás




Sistemas de Inteligencia Empresarial: Command Centers, Control Towers, Growth Control Systems, AI Operating Layers y Enterprise Intelligence OS.




Rentabilidad y Performance: Profitability Engines, unit economics, rentabilidad por cliente, producto, proyecto, activo o unidad de negocio, FP&A, forecasting y simulación.




Data & Analytics Engineering: Integración de Excel, ERPs, CRMs, bases SQL, APIs y otras fuentes; pipelines ETL/ELT, modelado de datos, calidad, reconciliación y plataformas modernas de datos.




IA Aplicada: RAG, agentes internos, búsqueda semántica, automatización de análisis, document intelligence, copilotos y workflows empresariales asistidos por IA.




Software y Data Apps: Aplicaciones ejecutivas, APIs, automatizaciones, herramientas operativas y software a medida conectado con datos y procesos reales.




Arquitectura a Medida: Soluciones construidas con el stack adecuado para cada caso, incluyendo MotherDuck, Snowflake, AWS u otras alternativas cuando aporten valor real.




Requisitos




* Experiencia en ventas B2B consultivas, business development, partnerships o desarrollo de cuentas.

* Capacidad real para generar oportunidades y construir pipeline propio.

* Experiencia conversando con decisores senior y vendiendo soluciones o proyectos de ticket relevante.

* Capacidad para entender problemas de negocio antes de presentar una solución.

* Familiaridad conceptual con datos, IA, cloud, automatización y software; no es necesario ser ingeniero.

* Excelente comunicación, negociación y seguimiento comercial.

* Autonomía para trabajar bajo esquema remoto y contractor.

* Disciplina, responsabilidad y disponibilidad real para atender oportunidades activas.

* Alto sentido de confidencialidad y visión de largo plazo.




Deseable




* Experiencia vendiendo consultoría tecnológica, data engineering, analytics, IA, cloud, software empresarial o transformación digital.

* Conocimiento general de plataformas como Snowflake, Databricks, MotherDuck, AWS, Azure, GCP o equivalentes.

* Red de contactos B2B en México con dueños, C-level o líderes de finanzas, operaciones, comercial y tecnología.

* Familiaridad con metodologías como SPIN Selling, Challenger o MEDDICC/MEDDPICC.

* Conocimiento de finanzas corporativas, FP&A, unit economics, procesos operativos o rentabilidad.

* Experiencia desarrollando alianzas, canales o ecosistemas comerciales.

* Inglés profesional.




Perfil ideal




Buscamos un operador comercial capaz de moverse entre negocio y tecnología sin caer en discurso superficial de IA.




Una persona que pueda conversar con un empresario sobre margen, crecimiento, inventario, flujo de caja, productividad o control operativo; detectar dónde existe un problema real; y después abrir el espacio correcto para que Afincore diseñe una solución con datos, software e IA.




No buscamos a alguien que solo envíe mensajes masivos, repita un pitch fijo o prometa tecnología antes de entender el contexto.




Buscamos criterio comercial, capacidad de seguimiento, ownership y disciplina para convertir oportunidades complejas en proyectos ejecutables.




Afincore respeta que el contractor pueda tener otros trabajos o proyectos. A cambio, exige responsabilidad, respuesta oportuna, reservas reales de tiempo para oportunidades activas y cumplimiento riguroso de los compromisos asumidos.




Qué Ofrecemos




* Participar en la construcción del motor comercial de Afincore desde una etapa temprana.

* Representar un offering de alto valor en inteligencia corporativa, ingeniería de datos, IA aplicada y software.

* Trabajar sobre problemas reales de negocio en múltiples industrias.

* Acceso directo al liderazgo y equipo técnico de Afincore para discovery, propuestas y cierres estratégicos.

* Libertad para proponer cuentas objetivo, verticales, alianzas y enfoques de go-to-market.

* Esquema remoto con autonomía y responsabilidad.

* Esquema contractor con participación del 10% en utilidades netas por cada proyecto cerrado.

* Potencial de crecimiento hacia mayor responsabilidad comercial conforme Afincore escale.




Afincore busca perfiles comerciales con criterio, disciplina y capacidad real para convertir problemas críticos de negocio en oportunidades ejecutables de datos, IA y software.

Juan - CEO

Venta consultiva, Gestión comercial, Desarrollo de red de contactos, Desarrollo de negocios, CRM, Snowflake, SPIN selling, Rentabilidad, Microsoft Azure, Intelligent automation (IA)

description:
About the job

I’m helping Decolure find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of DTC Operations Lead.




You'll drive DTC execution velocity and revenue growth by leading a data-driven team to ship impactful work.




Compensation:

USD 4K - 9K/month




Location:

Remote: Mexico




Mission of Decolure:

"We specialize in transforming a house into a home that the buyer is looking for, or a space that perfectly reflects your family’s style, needs and comfort (redesign)."




What makes you a strong candidate:

You are proficient in Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear.
You have +4 years experience in Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing).
English - Fully fluent




Responsibilities and more:

JOB TITLE: DTC Operations Lead

LOCATION: Remote

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full Time




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a DTC Operations Lead to be the single owner of execution velocity for our Shopify direct-to-consumer channel. This is the most critical hire in our DTC buildout. We already have the strategy, the specs, the infrastructure, and the data — what we need is someone to make sure the work actually ships, every day, every week, without strategic conversations getting stuck in a document on Google Drive.

You will NOT be the person running ad accounts (that's the Growth Marketer). You will NOT be the person writing Liquid code (that's Implementation Specialist). You will NOT be the person producing creative assets (that's UGC Creators + Content Producer). Your job is to make sure ALL of those people are shipping, on-brief, on-time, every single week — and that the work they produce moves our DTC readiness score, revenue, and margin in the right direction.

This role is 70% execution management, 20% strategic decision-making, 10% hands-on analytical work. If you want to run ads or build pages yourself, this is not the right role. If you thrive on turning chaos into rhythm and watching a team ship more in a month than most DTC teams ship in a quarter, keep reading.




ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Execution Velocity & Team Management — 50% of your time

Daily standup (async or sync) with Growth Marketer, Implementation Specialist, UGC Creators — 15 minutes max, focused on "what shipped yesterday, what ships today, what's blocked"

ClickUp ownership: every open task has a clear owner, deadline, and acceptance criteria; every completed task has a tested outcome

Weekly sprint planning from the backlog of 17 existing specs + incoming priorities

Weekly sprint review: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what changes next week

Remove blockers: if Implementation Specialist is stuck on a Klaviyo flow, you unblock within 24 hours — you don't let it sit for a week

Pull from the AI agent's prioritized recommendations and assign — you should never have a team member wondering what to work on

DTC Performance Accountability — 20% of your time

Own the top-line DTC KPIs: revenue, conversion rate, CAC, AOV, email list growth, repeat purchase rate, contribution margin

Weekly performance review with the team, using data from the AI agent's dashboards

Monthly performance review with the CEO: what moved, what didn't, why, and what you're changing

Quarterly P&L review: contribution margin, LTV:CAC, channel profitability

Accountable for moving the DTC Readiness Tracker from 62% to 90% within 90 days of starting

Strategic Decision-Making — 20% of your time

Decide what the team works on this week, this month, this quarter — aligned with CEO priorities

Evaluate competing priorities: when the agent surfaces a conversion leak vs. the Growth Marketer wants to test a new creative vs. Ahmad has a blog CTA to ship, you prioritize

Approve or reject A/B test recommendations (with data justification)

Approve creative briefs before UGC creators start production

Cross-channel coordination: when Amazon runs a promotion, you decide DTC's response; when TikTok wants to test a creator, you validate the DTC implications

Escalate to CEO only what requires CEO-level decisions (budget above $500/day, pricing changes, strategic shifts) — you handle everything else

Hands-On Analytical Work — 10% of your time

Read dashboards daily — you should know the top 5 DTC metrics before your team tasks

Read Microsoft Clarity session recordings weekly (not optional) — you should know firsthand where users get stuck on mobile

Spot-check the AI agent's recommendations — verify the logic, don't just rubber-stamp

Identify when the AI agent is missing context and feed it back (this makes the agent better over time)

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (90-DAY SCORECARD)

Month 1 — Command of the Team

Daily standup rhythm established with all team members

ClickUp fully groomed: every open task has owner, deadline, acceptance criteria

Weekly sprint + review cadence operating

All 17 existing specs triaged and prioritized into a 12-week roadmap

First 5 specs shipped to production (not just drafted — LIVE)

You can verbally walk the CEO through current DTC performance, top risks, and this week's priorities in 5 minutes without notes

Month 2 — Execution at Pace

At least 10 specs shipped to production (cumulative from month 1)

DTC Readiness Tracker moved from 62% to 72%+

Store-wide conversion rate improved 0.2pp+ from baseline

Meta ROAS above 1.5x sustained

Email list growth accelerating (measurable WoW)

Zero specs older than 30 days sitting "in progress" — everything moves or gets killed

Month 3 — DTC Revenue Inflection

DTC revenue trajectory toward $30K+/month

DTC Readiness Tracker at 85%+

Blended ROAS above 2x sustained

CAC trending toward $15 target

Team is operating without needing daily direction — sprint cadence is self-sustaining

Clear strategic plan for months 4-6 submitted to CEO




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have Experience (Non-Negotiable):

4+ years leading DTC e-commerce operations (Shopify, BigCommerce, or direct Shopify Plus) at a brand doing $500K-$10M/year

Demonstrable track record of running a cross-functional DTC team: paid media, CRO, email, content, implementation

Experience managing remote teams across time zones (you will manage people in 2-4 countries simultaneously)

Project management fluency: ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Linear, Monday — doesn't matter which, but you must have run a real backlog, not a checklist

Data literacy: you can read GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Klaviyo, and Search Console fluently — not an expert in each, but competent enough to verify a specialist's work

Strong communication: written (async updates, briefs, escalation emails) and verbal (CEO check-ins, team standups)

Fluent English: written and verbal — this is a CEO-facing and team-leadership role

Strong Preferences:

Experience at a company running DTC alongside Amazon (cross-channel dynamics are a daily reality here)

Experience with bedding, home, wellness, or premium lifestyle brands

Experience working with AI tools as part of daily workflow (not just "used ChatGPT a few times")

Shopify Plus admin experience (not required, but a plus)

Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, Judge.me, Gorgias, or similar tool fluency

Nice-to-Have:

Background as a former Growth Marketer or CRO specialist (you understand what your team is doing at a technical level)

Experience in a 5-10 person company (you understand scrappy execution, not Fortune 500 bureaucracy)

Experience building or scaling a DTC channel from <$500K to $2M+ ARR

Comfort with light Shopify theme edits, basic HTML/Liquid (so you can spot-check work)




WHAT WE PROVIDE

A fully built strategic and data infrastructure: 17 specs, 86 processes documented, 35+ automation scripts, 13 active crons, all platform APIs integrated

An AI operations agent that delivers daily analytics, weekly summaries, competitor intel, creative briefs, PDP audit specs, email flow designs, and P&L analysis — you inherit a research and planning team on day 1

A 90-day playbook to move DTC Readiness from 62% to 90% — not a blank page

Direct CEO access for decisions above your authority level — clear escalation path, no middle-management bureaucracy

Growing revenue trajectory: DTC is our #1 strategic growth priority for 2026-2027

Clear promotion path: as DTC scales to $2M+ ARR, this role evolves into Head of DTC




DEAL-BREAKERS — DO NOT APPLY IF:

Your experience is primarily Amazon or marketplace operations — the playbooks don't transfer

You've only ever been an individual contributor (paid media specialist, CRO analyst) — this is a management role requiring team leadership

You've only ever led large teams (15+ people with clear functional silos) — this is a scrappy execution role where you lead 4-6 people across functions

You prefer strategy over execution — this is 70% execution, 20% strategy, 10% analysis

You need extensive direction from above — you will be given goals and scorecards, not task lists

You're uncomfortable delegating to an AI agent or receiving AI-generated specs — that's a core workflow of this role




WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position. 

Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager

Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry

A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels

Employee discounts on Decolure products




Your potential leader(s):

Erik Fisher -



Desired Skills and Experience

Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing), Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear, Klaviyo, Growth marketing, Google Search Console, Data analysis

description:
About the job

Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC, a global leader in technology market intelligence, is seeking a market researcher to join our team. This role requires a mix of analytical abilities, attention to detail, proficiency in research methodologies, alongside excellent communication skills to convey complex information effectively.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in interpreting data, staying abreast of IT market trends and events, supporting their team with in-depth research, and working collaboratively to meet research objectives.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in supporting the authorship and delivery of IDC’s market intelligence products and services in a rapidly evolving information technology landscape. The role will focus on utilizing the latest market research methodologies and tools to uncover relevant data from internal and external data sources and synthesizing into market research content assets.

What You’ll Do


 Support IDC’s market research agenda by conducting in-depth primary and secondary research into IT markets and their impact on industries, namely energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing. 
 Have in-depth knowledge/experience and understanding in energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing business operations, either through working in these industries or executing consulting/research engagements 
 Track, monitor, and identify IT industry developments to identify and report on market shifts, patterns, and anomalies. 
 Collaborate with internal subject matter expert analysts to achieve research goals and produce deliverables efficiently. 
 Participate in ongoing professional development and contribute to team knowledge sharing. 
 Synthesize raw data into information and meaningful insights and deliver tailored content components and assets that address key business requirements. 
 Contribute to the creation of written research studies and presentations summarizing findings for internal and external stakeholders 


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree required; (business, economics, management information systems, technology marketing, product management or related field).
2-3 years of experience in market research, consulting, or analysis, ideally in the information technology sector, with knowledge in the energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing domain, with a flair toward writing research content.
Previous experience in roles such as market intelligence or competitive intelligence is preferred.
Outstanding written and strong verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with and across teams globally.
Experience with office productivity tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Some experience with any AI tools such as MS CoPilot, Google Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT, or other similar tools.
A strong interest in the IT market, including, but not limited in topics such as AI and data management, cloud platforms, security, enterprise applications, enterprise infrastructure, devices, networking, telecommunications, application development, and services.
Understanding and interest in the application of information technology to industry use cases.
Flexibility to work both independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.
Professional fluency in English.
Hybrid job, 2 times per week at the office.


Preferred Attributes


Experience working with or for technology vendors, IT distributors, or in a market research/consulting firm.
Experience working in or analyzing emerging markets within the technology sector.
Knowledge of business models, go-to-market strategies, and technology adoption patterns in enterprise IT.
Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new marker research methods and tools, analytical mindset, and a collaborative, supportive approach to teamwork.


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Niantic games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

description:
About the job

Description

Are you a UX/UI-minded content strategist who thrives on turning complex information into simple, conversion-driven experiences? Are you energized by the challenge of helping small and medium businesses in Mexico discover the tools they need to grow? Do you want to own the digital front door for one of the fastest-growing seller marketplaces in Latin America?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, consider joining the Mexico Marketplace team as a Content and Website Manager.

What You Will Do?

This role owns the end-to-end content experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, the primary destination for prospective sellers exploring how to sell on Amazon Mexico. The mission is clear: make it effortless for potential sellers to find, understand, and act on the information they need to start their business on Amazon.

You will combine UX/UI expertise with content strategy and data analysis to continuously improve the site experience. You will track free search sources to understand how sellers discover the site, then optimize every touchpoint from first click to completed registration.

To succeed, you will need to think like a designer, write like a marketer, and measure like an analyst, all while collaborating across a diverse set of internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

UX/UI Strategy and Execution: Own the information architecture, page layouts, and user flows on vender.amazon.com.mx. Ensure every page delivers a clear value proposition, intuitive navigation, and a frictionless path toward seller registration. Conduct usability reviews, propose wireframes, and work with design resources to implement improvements.

Content Management at Scale: Plan, create, publish, and maintain site content including landing pages, educational modules, FAQs, and program explainers. Ensure content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with active seller programs and promotions.

Free Search Source Tracking: Monitor organic traffic performance across Google and AI-powered search surfaces. Identify keyword opportunities, track ranking changes, and coordinate content updates to maximize discoverability without paid spend.

Conversion Optimization: Own the visitor-to-registration funnel. Design and run A/B tests on layouts, copy, and CTAs. Analyze drop-off points, recommend improvements backed by data, and report on conversion metrics to leadership.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with Program Managers, Product Managers, and Commercial teams. Translate business priorities, new program launches, and policy changes into user-friendly site content within rapid turnaround cycles.

Performance Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track organic traffic, conversion rates, content freshness, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights to stakeholders with clear recommendations for next steps.

What We Are Looking For

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Demonstrate

A strong UX/UI foundation: experience with wireframing, prototyping, user research, and usability testing.

A true hands-on approach to content creation and site management, comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the CMS daily.

The ability to translate complex business and program information into simple, action-oriented content that converts.

A data-driven mindset: comfort defining KPIs, running experiments, interpreting analytics, and presenting results.

Strong internal customer service focus, able to interface at all levels of the organization, from operational teams to senior leadership.

A solutions-oriented approach: comfortable identifying problems and driving appropriate fixes without waiting for direction.

Bias for action, strong work ethic, and desire to achieve excellence in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Enthusiasm for collaborative work and a drive to create a positive, high-performance team culture.

Success in this role requires influential partnership with Program, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure vender.amazon.com.mx delivers the best possible experience for potential sellers in Mexico. If you are passionate about using design thinking and content strategy to change the trajectory of small businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the content strategy and UX/UI experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, ensuring prospective sellers in Mexico can easily discover, understand, and act on the information needed to start selling on Amazon.

Design and maintain site user flows, page layouts, and information architecture. Conduct usability reviews and implement improvements that reduce friction in the seller registration funnel.

Plan, publish, and update site content (landing pages, FAQs, educational modules) in coordination with Program, Product, and Commercial teams. Ensure all content reflects current programs and promotions within 48 to 72 hours of changes.

Track and analyze free search traffic sources. Identify organic keyword opportunities, monitor ranking performance, and optimize content for discoverability across search engines and AI-powered surfaces.

Run A/B tests on layouts, messaging, and CTAs. Measure conversion at each funnel stage, report findings to stakeholders, and implement data-backed improvements.

Partner cross-functionally to translate complex business requirements into clear, conversion-oriented site experiences. Serve as the primary point of contact for all content and UX requests related to the Mexico seller acquisition site.

Maintain performance dashboards covering organic traffic, conversion rates, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights with actionable recommendations.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing organic traffic dashboards, identifying which pages are gaining traction and where drop-offs occur. You then jump into the CMS to publish updated landing page content requested by the Program team. Mid-morning, you join a sync with Product Managers to align on an upcoming registration flow change and plan the corresponding site updates. After lunch, you review A/B test results, document findings, and share recommendations with the Commercial team. Your customer is the prospective seller in Mexico who needs a clear, frictionless path from search result to completed registration.

About The Team

The Seller Marketing Team owns the full marketing funnel for Amazon Mexico's seller ecosystem. The mission: make Amazon the first choice for every business in Mexico looking to sell online. The team attracts potential sellers, converts them into registrations, and keeps them engaged and growing. This means working across awareness, acquisition, and retention, always with a bias toward experimentation and measurable impact. The culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and seller-obsessed. Team members take ownership of outcomes end-to-end and partner across product, program, and commercial functions to deliver results

Basic Qualifications


 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Experience in A/B testing
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
 Bachelor's degree
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, Axure, Keynote, and InVision
 Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields
 Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams
 Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
 Experience with a variety of design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Fireworks, Visio, Axure, and Dreamweaver

Oliver Wyman is seeking a Product Strategy Designer to strengthen product strategy through design at the initiative and epic level, operating upstream of delivery. This role sits within the Global Creative Studio and partners closely with Product Strategy, Product Design, and Research teams to shape product direction before execution decisions are made.




The Product Strategy Designer focuses on concept development, value articulation, and strategic design to support investment decisions, prioritization, and roadmap definition. Consistently grounded in user insight and research

About the job

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

México was Tilt’s first market outside the US. Launched in 2022, we’ve already helped thousands of customers access fair credit in moments of need — using alternative data and technology to serve those often overlooked by traditional lenders. We’re scaling rapidly and preparing to launch new products that will expand our reach and deepen our impact across the country.

The Opportunity: Performance Marketing Manager

We are seeking a Performance Marketing Manager to scale our mobile acquisition engine in Mexico. We've already built a live, growing business - and we're investing significantly to accelerate it. Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get At Tilt

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. About the job

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. As the clinical and advanced therapy part of UPS Healthcare, we reach patients faster, with greater scalability and access to new pathways throughout the supply chain. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

About the job
